title: DECREE DIVINE ALIGNMENT OVER THE NEW WEEK
text: I want you to share this prayer with somebody. There's a grace upon [music] it. When you share what God is doing, you're not just informing people. You're transferring grace. The Bible says in Philippians 1:6 that the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus. So before we go into this prophetic engagement this morning, share this prayer. Tag somebody. Send it to that brother. Send it to that sister who needs divine alignment. There are people in your life who are living below their prophetic capacity. Not because they lack potential, but because they lack alignment. And this morning, the spirit of God wants to use you as a vessel to decree alignment into their lives. Now, lift up your hands wherever you are. I don't know where you're joining me from. Whether you're in your bedroom, in your car, in your office, or you've stepped aside from the demands of life to seek the face of God. But I want you to understand that this is not just another prayer session. This is a prophetic moment. There is a frequency in the realm of the spirit that when you connect with things that have been disjointed begin to come together. The Bible says in Amos 3:23, can two work together except they be agreed? Agreement is alignment. And when you align with the purposes of God, when you align with the timing of God, when you align with the seasons of God, suddenly grace begins to flow. The word alignment speaks of positioning. It speaks of arrangement. It speaks of the proper ordering of things according to divine orchestration. You see, many believers are struggling not because they are not anointed, not because they don't have gifts, not because they lack calling, but because they are misaligned. You can be a POWERFUL ENGINE IN A VEHICLE, but if the wheels are not aligned, you will wear yourself out and never reach your destination. That's why the Bible says in Ecclesiastes 10:10, "If the iron be blunt and he do not wet the edge, then must he put to more strength." But wisdom is profitable to direct. Direction is alignment. Wisdom brings you into the proper positioning where your strength produces maximum results. This morning as we step into a new week, I am decreeing by the authority of the word of God and by the leading of the Holy Spirit that every form of misalignment in your life is coming to an end. Every relationship that is pulling you away from your divine assignment, I decree separation by fire. Every opportunity that looks good but is not God, I decree divine clarity. Every voice that is confusing your spirit, I decree spiritual sensitivity to discern what is of God and what is of the enemy. The Bible says in 1 Corinthians 14:33, "For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace." Where there is confusion, there is misalignment, but where there is peace, there is the presence of God orchestrating things in divine order. Now, I need you to pray with me. Open your mouth and begin to pray in the Holy Ghost. If you have the gift of tongues, engage it now. If you don't pray with your understanding, but pray with fire. Say, "Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for the gift of alignment. I thank you that you are a God of order, a God of precision, a God of timing. And I ask this morning that every area of my life that is out of sync with your divine will, let the spirit of God bring correction. Let the spirit of God bring adjustment. Let the spirit [music] of God bring realignment in the mighty name of Jesus. Pray in tonesues. Release your spirit now. Let the Holy Ghost take over your speech. When you pray in tonesues, you are praying the perfect will of God [music] because your mind is unfruitful. But your spirit is making intercession according to the will of God. Romans 8:26 says, "Likewise, the spirit also helpeth our infirmities. For we know not what we should pray for as we ought, but the spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered. There are alignments that your natural mind cannot articulate, but your spirit knows what needs to be aligned. So pray, release your spirit. Engage the Holy Ghost. Now, as you continue praying, I want to prophesy to somebody. The Lord says, "I have seen your struggles. I have seen how you've been trying to make things work. I have seen how you've been pushing doors that I have not opened. I have seen how you've been pursuing relationships that I have not ordained. I have seen how you've been investing your energy, your time, your resources in ventures that are outside of my timing. But this week, I am bringing you into alignment. I am bringing you into the center of my will. And when you come into the center of my will, you will discover that what you've been struggling to achieve by your own effort will begin to flow by my grace. For my yoke is easy and my burden is light. You see, when you are aligned with God, life becomes easier. Not because there are no challenges, but because grace is present. Grace is the supernatural enablement of God that makes difficult things easy. The Bible says in Zechariah 4:6-7, "Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, sayeth the Lord of hosts. Who art thou, oh great mountain, before Zerubbabel, thou shalt become a plain." When the spirit of God is involved, mountains become plains, but you must be aligned with the spirit. You cannot be walking in the flesh and expect the results of the spirit. You cannot be living in disobedience and expect the blessings of obedience. Alignment demands submission. Alignment demands surrender. Alignment demands that you lay aside your own agenda and embrace the agenda of heaven. Now I prophesy to you this morning. Every mountain of delay in your life because you are coming into alignment this week. That mountain is becoming a plane. Every obstacle that has been standing between you and your breakthrough because of the decree of alignment that obstacle is being removed. The Bible says in Isaiah 45:2, "I will go before thee and make the crooked places straight. I will break in pieces the gates of brass and cut in sunder the bars of iron." When God aligns you, he goes before you and prepares the way. He doesn't send you into battle unprepared. He doesn't send you into assignments without equipping you. Divine alignment comes with divine provision, divine protection, and divine promotion. Lift up your voice again and pray. Say, "Father, I receive divine alignment over my weak. I receive alignment in my relationships. Father, connect me to the people you have ordained for me to walk with in this season. Disconnect me from every relationship that is a distraction, every relationship that is draining my anointing, every relationship that is taking me away from my assignment. I receive alignment in my finances. Father, let my resources be directed by your wisdom. Let my investments be guided by your spirit. Let my giving be according to your leading. I receive alignment in my health. Father, let every system in my body function according to how you created it. I come against every form of malfunction, every form of disorder, every form of disease. Let there be alignment and divine health in my body. I receive alignment in my career. Father, position me in the place where my gifts will be celebrated, where my anointing will be recognized, where my contribution will make maximum impact. I come against every form of stagnation, every form of limitation, every form of demotion. I decree promotion, elevation, and divine positioning in the name of Jesus. Keep praying. Don't stop. This is a critical moment when you decree. You are not begging God. You are enforcing the will of God. The Bible says in Job 22:28, "Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, and the light shall shine upon thy ways." Decree means to make an authoritative pronouncement. You have been given authority as a believer. Jesus said in Luke 10:19, "Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy, and nothing shall by any means hurt you. You are not powerless. You are not helpless. You are not a victim. You are a son. You are a daughter. You are seated with Christ in heavenly places. And from that position, you have authority to decree and declare. Now, let me teach you something about alignment. There are three dimensions of alignment that every believer must experience [music] if they are going to walk in the fullness of their destiny. The first is alignment with God. The second is alignment with purpose. The third is alignment with people. Let me break this down for you because this is critical. First, alignment with God. This is the foundation of everything. If you are not aligned with God, nothing else matters. You can be aligned with your purpose, but if your relationship with God is broken, you will lack the power to fulfill that purpose. You can be aligned with the right people, but if God is not in the center, those relationships will eventually collapse. The Bible says in Matthew 6:33, "But seek ye first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things shall be added onto you." Seeking first means priority. It means that God is not an addition to your life. He's the foundation of your life. When you are aligned with God, you pray, you study the word, you worship, you obey his voice, you honor his principles. Alignment with God is not just about going to church. is about [music] a lifestyle of fellowship, a lifestyle of consecration, a lifestyle of surrender. Many believers are not experiencing the fullness of God's promises because they are not aligned with him. They want the blessings, but they don't want the relationship. They want the miracles, but they [music] don't want the intimacy. But I prophesy to you this morning, there is a hunger arising in your spirit for God himself. Not just for what he can do, but for who he is. And as you pursue him, as you seek his face, as you make him your priority, everything else will fall into alignment. The Bible says in Psalm 37:4, "Delight thyself also in the Lord, and he shall give thee [music] the desires of thine heart. When you delight in him, he aligns your desires with his desires, and what you want becomes what he wants." Pray with me. Say, "Father, I realign myself with you today. Forgive me for every moment I have prioritized other things above you. Forgive me for every time I have sought the blessing instead of the blesser. Forgive me for every distraction that has pulled me away from fellowship with you. Today, I make a decision to seek you first. I make a decision to prioritize prayer, to prioritize the word, to prioritize worship, to prioritize obedience. Holy Spirit, help me to stay aligned with the father. Help me to hear his voice clearly. Help me to follow his leading completely. In the name [music] of Jesus, I pray. The second dimension is alignment with purpose. Every person was created for a reason. You are not an accident. You are not a mistake. God formed you in your mother's womb with intention. The Bible says in Jeremiah 1:5, "Before I formed thee in the belly, I knew thee. And before thou comest forth out of the womb, I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a [music] prophet unto the nations. Before you were born, God had already determined your assignment. He had already prepared works for you to walk in. Ephesians 2:10 says, "For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, [music] which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them." You were created for good works. Not just any works, but specific works that God prepared in advance for you. But many believers are living outside of their purpose. They are doing good things, but not God things. They are busy but not fruitful. They are active but not aligned. And when you are outside of your purpose, you experience frustration. You experience emptiness. You experience a lack of fulfillment because you were not designed to live outside of your purpose. You were designed to function within the framework of God's plan for your life. And when you are in that place, you experience joy. You experience peace. You experience fulfillment even in the midst of challenges. I prophesy to you today, this week is a week of clarity. If you have been confused about your purpose, if you have been asking God, what is my assignment? What am I supposed to be doing with my life? I decree by the spirit of the Lord that clarity is coming. The Bible says in Habachuk 2:2, "And the Lord answered me and said, write the vision and make it plain upon tables that he may run that readth it." God is going to make your vision plain. He's going to show you what you are supposed to be doing. He's going to show you where you are supposed to be investing your time and [music] your energy. And when he reveals it, write it down. Make it plain and then run with it. Don't hesitate. Don't second guessess. Don't allow fear to paralyze you. When God reveals your purpose, [music] step into it with boldness. Now pray. Say, "Father, align me with my purpose. Show me what you created me to do. Show me the assignment you have for me in this season. remove every form of confusion, every form of distraction, every form of discouragement that is keeping me from stepping into my purpose. I decree that I'm walking in the center of your will. I decree that I'm fulfilling my divine assignment. I decree that my life is making the impact you intended it to make in the name of Jesus. The third dimension is alignment with people. You cannot fulfill your destiny alone. You need people. You need relationships. You need connections. The Bible says in Proverbs 27:17, "Ron sharpeneth iron." So, a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend. You need people who will sharpen you, who will challenge you, who will push you, who will encourage you. But not just any people. You need the right people. You need people who are aligned with your vision, people who are aligned with your values, people who are aligned with your destiny. One of the greatest tragedies in the body of Christ is believers who are connected to the wrong people. They are in relationships that are draining them. Relationships that are distracting them, relationships that are pulling them away from God's purposes, and they wonder why they are not making progress is because you cannot walk with the wrong people and arrive at the right destination. The Bible says in 2 Corinthians 6:14, "Be ye not unequally yolked together with unbelievers. For what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness, [music] and what communion hath light with darkness?" You have to be careful who you are yolked with. You have to be careful who you are doing life with, because wrong associations produce [music] wrong destinations. But I prophesy to you this morning, God is bringing divine connections into your life this week. People who are aligned with your destiny. People who carry grace for your assignment. People who will open doors that you could not open by yourself. People who will speak words that will shift your life. People who will invest in you, mentor you, coach you, and help you become everything God has called you to be. The Bible says in Psalm 68:6, God setted the solitary in families. If you have been feeling isolated, if you have been feeling alone, God is bringing you into divine alignment with people who will become family to you. Pray with me. Say, "Father, I thank you for divine connections. I thank you for bringing the right people into my life. I ask that you remove every wrong connection, every toxic relationship, every person who is pulling me away from my destiny. And I ask that you bring me into alignment with people who will sharpen me, who will challenge me, who will encourage me, who will support me, who will celebrate me. I decree that I'm surrounded by divine relationships. I decree that I'm walking with the right people. I decree that I'm connected to my destiny helpers in the name of Jesus. Now, let me show you something else about alignment. When you are aligned, you experience acceleration. Things begin to move faster. Doors begin to open quicker. Opportunities begin to present themselves more frequently. The Bible says in Deuteronomy 28 to2, "And all these blessings shall come on thee and overtake thee if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God. The blessings overtake you." You don't have to chase them. You don't have to beg for them. When you are aligned with God, when you are walking in obedience, the blessings pursue you. They overtake you. They catch up with you. I prophesy acceleration over your life this week. Things that have been moving slowly, I decree acceleration. Projects that have been delayed, I decree acceleration. Breakthroughs that have been tiring, I decree acceleration. The Bible says in Isaiah 60-22, "A little one shall become a thousand and a small one a strong nation. I, the Lord, will hasten it in his time." God is hastening things in your life. What would have taken years is going to happen in months. What would have taken months is going to happen in weeks. What would have taken [music] weeks is going to happen in days. Because when God accelerates, time collapses. When God accelerates, processes are shortened. When God accelerates, you experience suddenly. Open your mouth and prophesy to [music] yourself. Say, "I am entering into acceleration. I am entering into a season of suddenly. Things are shifting in my favor. Doors are opening for me. Opportunities are presenting themselves to me. Favor is surrounding me. Grace is empowering me. I am walking in divine alignment. And because I am aligned, I am experiencing acceleration in the name of Jesus. Now, let me pray a prophetic prayer over you. Father, in the name of Jesus, I come before your throne of grace with boldness. I thank you for everyone who is connected to this prayer right now. I thank you for their hunger. I thank you for their desperation. I thank you for their faith. And Lord, I ask that you would release a spirit of alignment over their lives. Every area that is out of order, let there be divine adjustment. Every relationship that is not of you, let there be separation. Every opportunity that is a distraction, let there be closure. Every door that you have opened, let it remain open. Every door that you have closed, let no man open it. Father, I decree alignment in their time. Let them be at the right place at the right time. Let them meet the right people at the right moment. Let them receive the right information at the right hour. I come against every spirit of delay, every spirit of procrastination, every spirit of distraction. I bind confusion. I bind double-mindedness. I bind anxiety. I bind fear. And I release clarity. I release focus. I release divine direction. I release supernatural peace. Let the peace of God which passes all understanding guard their hearts and their minds in Christ Jesus. Father, I decree alignment in their finances. Let their resources be multiplied. [music] Let their income increase. Let their investments prosper. Let their businesses flourish. Let their careers advance. I come against every form of lack, every form of poverty, every form of limitation. I decree abundance. I decree overflow. I decree more than enough. Let them be lenders and not borrowers. Let them be the head and not the tail. Let them be above only and [music] not beneath. Father, I decree alignment in their health. Let every organ in their body function according to your design. Let every system operate in divine order. I speak to cancers. I command them to die. I speak to diseases. I command them to live. I speak to pain. I command it to go. I release healing. I release wholeness. I release strength. I release vitality. Let them walk in divine health all the days of their lives. Father, I decree alignment in their families. Let there be peace in their homes. Let there be love in their marriages. Let there be unity among their children. I come against every spirit of division, every spirit of strife, every spirit of rebellion. I release the spirit of reconciliation, the spirit of forgiveness, the spirit of restoration. Let their families be a reflection of your glory. Let their homes be a habitation of your presence. Father, I decree alignment in their ministries. Let them walk in their divine assignments. Let them fulfill their kingdom mandates. Let them make the impact you have called them to make. I release fresh anointing. I release fresh fire. I release fresh grace. Let them be empowered by the Holy Spirit to do the works of Jesus. Let signs, wonders, and miracles follow them. Let the sick be healed through their prayers. Let the oppressed be delivered through their ministry. Let the lost be [music] saved through their witness. Father, I decree alignment in their minds. Let their thoughts be your thoughts. Let their perspectives be your perspectives. Let their desires be your desires. I come against every stronghold, every vain imagination, every high thing that exalts itself against the knowledge of God. I pull them down by the authority of your word and by the power of [music] the Holy Ghost. And I decree that every thought is brought into captivity to the obedience of Christ. Now, Father, I seal this decree with the blood of Jesus. Let it be established in the heavens and manifested on the earth. Let no weapon formed against it prosper. Let no tongue that rises against it in judgment be condemned. For this is the heritage of the servants of the Lord and their righteousness is of you. In the mighty name of Jesus I have prayed. Amen. Now I want you to receive this prophetically. This is not just a prayer. This is a decree. And a decree has authority. When you agree with what has been declared, you are partnering with heaven to see it manifested on earth. The Bible says in Matthew 18:19, "Again, I say unto you that if two of you shall agree on earth as touching anything that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my father which is in heaven." You and I have agreed in prayer. Heaven has witnessed our agreement. And what we have decreed is already established in the realm of the spirit. Now we wait expectantly to see the manifestation in the natural. But let me tell [music] you something. Alignment is not a one-time event. Alignment is a continuous process. You have to maintain your alignment. You have to guard your alignment. The enemy is constantly looking for ways to pull you out of alignment. He will use distractions. He will use offenses. He will [music] use temptations. He will use delays. He will use disappointments. But you have to be vigilant. You have to be watchful. The Bible says in 1 Peter 5:8, [music] "Be sober. Be vigilant because your adversary, the devil, as a roaring lion walketh about, seeking whom he may devour." He's seeking. He's looking for opportunities. But when you are alert, when you are spiritually sensitive, when you are prayed up, you can discern his devices and you can resist him. So as you go into this week, I want you to make a commitment to maintain your alignment. Start every day with prayer. Start every day with the word. Start every day by surrendering to the lordship of Jesus Christ. And at the end of every day, take inventory. Ask yourself, was I aligned today? Did I honor God with my decisions? Did I honor God with my words? Did I honor God with my actions? And where you fell short, repent. Where you missed it, ask for forgiveness. And where you succeeded, give God the glory. I see a prophetic picture. I see a river. And this river is flowing is flowing with power, is flowing with purpose, is flowing with provision. And I see people standing on the banks of this river and they are watching the river flow. but they're not in the river. And the Lord says, [music] "Tell my people to get into the flow. Tell them to stop watching from the sidelines. Tell them to step into the current because when they step into the flow, they will be carried by the current. They won't have to struggle. They won't have to strive. They will simply yield to the movement of the spirit and they will be taken to places they could never reach by their own effort. That river is the river of divine alignment. Is the river of God's purposes. is the river of God's timing and God is inviting you to step into it. Stop standing on the banks. Stop being a spectator. Step into the flow. Yield to the current. Surrender to the movement of the Holy Spirit and watch how [music] he carries you into your destiny. I decree that you are stepping into the flow this week. I decree that you are yielding to the spirit of God. I decree that you are being carried by divine grace into your expected end. The Bible says in Jeremiah 29-11, "For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, sayeth the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil to give you an expected end." God has an expected end for you. He has a destination planned for you. And when you are aligned with him, [music] you will reach that destination. Now, before we close this prayer session, I want to give you a practical instruction. This week, I want you to be intentional about three things. First, be intentional about your time with God. Don't let anything steal your time with him. Not your job, not your business, not your family, not your ministry. Make time with God non-negotiable. Even if it's just 30 minutes in the morning, be consistent. Let him have access to you every single day. Second, be intentional about obeying the prompings of the Holy Spirit. When the Holy Spirit tells you to do something, do it immediately. Don't delay. Don't negotiate. Don't rationalize. Just obey. Because obedience is the pathway to alignment. The Bible says in 1 Samuel 15:22, "Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams. Obedience positions you for blessing." Third, be intentional about your associations. Pay attention to the people you are spending [music] time with. Pay attention to the conversations you are engaging in. Pay attention to the environments you're exposing yourself to. If it's not aligned with where God is taking you, create distance. You don't have to be rude. You don't have to be harsh, but you [music] have to be wise. Proverbs 4:23 says, "Keep thy heart with all diligence. For out of it are the issues of life. Guarding your heart includes guarding your associations." Now, lift up your hands one more time. I want to release a final blessing over you. May the Lord bless you and keep you. May the Lord make his face to shine upon you and be gracious unto you. May the Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace. May you walk in divine alignment all the days of your life. May you experience the fullness of God's purposes for your life. May you fulfill your divine assignment without hindrance, without delay, without distraction. May [music] you prosper in all your ways. May your path be illuminated by the light of God's presence. May your steps be ordered by the word of the Lord. May your life be a testimony of God's faithfulness, God's [music] goodness, and God's glory in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Amen and amen. Go into this week with confidence. Go with boldness. Go with faith. You are aligned. You are positioned. You are empowered. And you are destined to win. Shalom.
